slip.order: frame-major: buf[f*n + i] is element i at frame f

critical_friction.meaning: critical_friction[i_theta][i] is the largest mu INDEX at which element i still slips at that orientation. The active set is nested in mu at almost every orientation but not quite all, so this is the LAST mu that slips and not a guarantee that every lower mu does; the viewer reads membership from the per-frame slip array, which is exact regardless.

regional_stress.note: compression positive; axes[0] is the maximum compression direction (SHmax), axes[2] the minimum
